images.title: Heights of two families
images.purpose: Show the two families' heights as dot plots on the same scale so the far away value 118 cm stands out.
images.composition: Two horizontal dot plots stacked one above the other, sharing the same scale from 115 to 175 cm.
exact_structure: Top dot plot labelled Yaangba's family: a number line from 115 to 175 with numbered ticks every 10 (115, 125, 135, 145, 155, 165, 175) and exactly 6 teal (#0072B2) dots at 155, 160, 164, 165, 169, 173.
Bottom dot plot labelled Poovizhi's family: the same number line and exactly 5 amber (#E69F00) dots at 118, 165, 170, 173, 175.
The amber dot at 118 is far to the left of the other four amber dots, with a wide empty gap between 118 and 165.
Both lines are drawn in dark grey with ticks at every 5 cm, and the caption Height (in cm) sits under the bottom line.
rejection: the two plots drawn on different scales
any dot labelled with a name
the 118 dot placed close to the others
images.takeaway: One very short member pulls Poovizhi's family mean down, while the middle value hardly moves.
images.description: Two dot plots on a scale from 115 to 175 cm: six teal dots for Yaangba's family and five amber dots for Poovizhi's family, one of them alone at 118.
images.context: Shown beside the concept text and video for this concept.
images.teaching_notes: Ask which family has a value far from the others before any calculation.

image_decisions.why: The far away value 118 cm is seen at once on a dot plot.
